entries.summary: Completed provider batches could still strand score persistence because stage activities had no retries after provider completion and batch file polling had no transport retry budget.
entries.fix_summary: Added bounded stage retries, explicit OpenAI batch/file transport retries, and persisted batch lifecycle ownership so completed batches can resume polling/apply instead of relying on a single fragile attempt.

entries.summary: The separate projectProcessState activity timed out too aggressively under score-stage load, producing late completion warnings and stale campaign health reads.
entries.fix_summary: Projection timeout is now settings-driven with a higher default budget, while keeping projection retries at a single attempt to avoid duplicate projection churn.

entries.summary: V3 cohort status still depended on broad experiment/run scans and global stuck-work reads, which timed out during large score stages.
entries.fix_summary: Campaign status now scopes experiment listing to the explicit manifest tag set and derives cohort stuckness from process_observability for the latest run per experiment.

entries.summary: The subset score parser still rejects some model outputs that include multiple stage identifiers on the verdict line, causing terminal score_gen failures and blocking downstream score_critic on those targets.
entries.fix_summary: Relaxed subset verdict parsing so multi-label `VERDICT:` lines with commas and markdown emphasis are accepted instead of treated as terminal parse failures.
examples: Failed to parse verdict line with narrative plus VERDICT: ThKMhJ, vcPIJZ

entries.summary: The `resetV3Campaign` action still builds the entire 18-experiment cohort into one Convex function call, which now regularly times out under the new dataset chunking strategy.
entries.fix_summary: Refactored campaign reset into scheduled incremental per-run cleanup backed by `continueRunReset`, and increased the per-pass delete budget so a full live cohort drains back to `preflight_clean` without timing out.

entries.summary: Large `score_gen` chunks could fire hundreds of `recordLlmAttemptStart` mutations at once before batch registration, leaving no preamble heartbeat coverage on that fanout and causing `ensureBatchExecution` to time out before a provider batch was ever bound.
entries.fix_summary: Run-stage batch preamble now records batch attempt starts with bounded concurrency and emits `batch_preamble:record_attempt_starts` heartbeats under the same preflight guard before quota reservation and batch registration continue.
examples: Timed out preparing batch execution for score_gen run kx74fke6hrm6q2pk1ag0rzed1h83dnxr
score_gen batch reconciliation showed failed 500-item and 100-item chunks with provider_batch_id=null and 0/600 completed targets

entries.summary: Even after the first score-stage preamble hardening, full-cohort `score_gen` runs can still time out while recording batch attempt-start rows, failing the workflow before any `llm_batch_executions` row or provider batch is created.
entries.fix_summary: Persisted batch-preparation progress directly on `llm_batch_executions` (`attempt_recorded_count`, `attempt_records_json`), create/restore that execution before staging new attempt-start writes, page `recordLlmAttemptStart` work across replay-safe checkpoints, and convert remaining preamble failures into explicit `markRunProcessError` writes so the concrete score-stage cause survives outside Railway logs.
examples: Timed out recording batch attempts for score_gen run kx79rnmhjxzdxejhbvns174fm983d6gf
Timed out recording batch attempts for score_gen run kx74z0v86fw8mmty27q44h3zpd83djhf
score_gen batch reconciliation on representative failed runs showed batch_count=0 with started attempts but no succeeded or failed score attempts
entries.validation_summary: Full live V3 cohort completed with zero errors. Representative run `kx73pkbf3wm136p046gkwxne1583cjbd` checkpointed all 120 score_gen attempts, bound provider batch `batch_69c07b0d91bc8190a986043975f85659`, and completed score_gen + score_critic without reproducing the timeout.

entries.summary: Forced active-run cleanup still leaves late run-stage callbacks racing into deleted rows, producing `Run not found` / `Score target not found for run` errors after the cohort has already been reset to `preflight_clean`.
entries.fix_summary: The Convex worker now treats late `applyRunStageResult` and `markRunStageFailure` callbacks against deleted run/sample/score-target/rubric rows as safe no-ops with run-trace breadcrumbs, mirroring the earlier missing-attempt and missing-window cleanup hardening. Live ownDev failure logs were quiet after the push; the next forced reset remains the proving pass.

entries.summary: Score-stage OpenAI batches can remain legitimately alive beyond the engine's prior `2h` internal wait ceiling, causing the workflow to fail even though the provider batch is still inside the provider's `24h` completion window.
entries.fix_summary: Aligned `llm.batching.maxWaitMs` to `24h` and raised `temporal.activityStartToCloseMs` to `26h` so batch-backed stages can wait through the full provider window while still surfacing an explicit batch-timeout error if that longer budget is actually exceeded.
examples: OpenAI batch batch_69c179e27b948190ae7670f39aaa4f7e exceeded max wait of 7200000ms
